info.title: ProjectX Gateway API
info.description: ProjectX Gateway API Documentation and specification.

post.summary: Searches for accounts based on the provided request.
Login as the specified user using the specified application.
Login as the specified user using the specified API key.
Logs out the current authenticated user.
Validates the current user's session.
Searches for contracts based on the provided search criteria.

parameters.name: request
parameters.description: The search criteria for finding contracts.

200.description: A response containing the search results, including any matching contracts.

post.summary: Searches for a contract by its ID.

parameters.name: request
parameters.description: The request containing the contract ID.

200.description: A response containing the search result, including the matching contract if found.

post.summary: Lists available contracts based on the provided request parameters.

parameters.name: request
parameters.description: The listing criteria for available contracts.

200.description: A response containing the list of available contracts.

post.summary: Retrieves historical bars based on the specified request parameters.

parameters.name: request
parameters.description: The request containing parameters for retrieving historical bars.

200.description: The response with the retrieved bars.

post.summary: Searches for orders based on the provided request.
Searches for a single order by its ID on an account owned by the authenticated user.

parameters.name: request
parameters.description: A request containing the account ID and order ID.

200.description: A response containing the matching order, or a not-found error code when the order does not exist on an account owned by the user.

post.summary:
Searches for orders with Open status on an account. Does not
include Suspended bracket children — use /v2/query
with Statuses: [Open, Suspended] to fetch those alongside open orders.
Paginated order search with optional filtering by status, contract, and creation timestamp.

parameters.name: request
parameters.description: A request containing filter criteria and pagination.

200.description: A response with the matching page of orders and the optional total count.

post.summary: Places a new order based on the provided request.

200.description: A response with order placement details.

post.summary: Cancels an existing order based on the provided request.

parameters.name: request
parameters.description: A request containing order cancellation details.

200.description: A response with order cancellation details.

post.summary: Modifies an existing order based on the provided request.

parameters.name: request
parameters.description: A request containing order modification details.

200.description: A response with order modification details.

post.summary: Searches for open positions based on the provided request.
Closes a contract position based on the provided request.

parameters.name: request
parameters.description: A request containing the account ID and contract ID to close.

200.description: A response indicating the success or failure of the close operation.

post.summary: Partially closes a contract position based on the provided request.

parameters.name: request
parameters.description: A request containing the account ID, contract ID, and size to close.

200.description: A response indicating the success or failure of the partial close operation.

get.summary: Handles the ping request to check the status of the API.

200.description: Returns a "pong" to indicate the API is responsive.

post.summary: Searches for half-turn trades based on the provided request parameters.

200.description: A response with the search results.
